places.name: VILLArue 1891
places.blurb: Our celebration venue: a historic villa on the Rhine with a terrace overlooking the vineyards. Rheinstraße 5, 65385 Rüdesheim am Rhein.

places.name: KD pier Mainz (Rheinufer, near Fischtor/Rathaus)
places.blurb: KD Köln-Düsseldorfer scheduled boat to Rüdesheim. 2026 high season (25 Apr–4 Oct, daily except Mon): dep 09:15 → Biebrich 09:30 → Eltville 10:00 → Rüdesheim 11:00 (1h45). Return Rüdesheim 16:20 → Mainz 18:40. Approx €28 single / €31 return (2026 zone G). 2027 timetable not yet published. Times are from the 2026 timetable; 2027 TBC.

places.name: KD pier Wiesbaden-Biebrich (Schloss Biebrich)
places.blurb: KD stop opposite Biebrich Palace. 2026: dep 09:30 → Rüdesheim 11:00 (1h30), daily except Mon; return arrives 18:10. Approx €28/€31. Bus 4/14 from Wiesbaden centre. Times are from the 2026 timetable; 2027 TBC.

places.name: Rüdesheim boat piers (KD & Bingen-Rüdesheimer)
places.blurb: Main passenger piers on Rheinstraße, about 6 min walk from the villa. KD boats from Mainz and Biebrich arrive here at 11:00 (2026 timetable; 2027 TBC). Bingen-Rüdesheimer ticket office at Anleger 8 & 10.

places.name: Car ferry Bingen–Rüdesheim (Rüdesheim side, B42)
places.blurb: Bingen-Rüdesheimer car ferry, daily all year. Summer (1 Apr–31 Oct 2026) continuous service 05:30 (Bingen)/05:40 (Rüdesheim) until 23:50/24:00. Foot passenger €2.70, car ≤3t €5.90 (+ energy surcharge since 21 Apr 2026). Not affected by low water.

places.name: Car ferry Bingen–Rüdesheim (Bingen side, Hafenstraße)
places.blurb: Bingen landing of the car ferry; ~10 min walk to Bingen Stadt station.

places.name: Passenger ferry Bingen (Brücke 4/5, Rheinkai)
places.blurb: Bingen-Rüdesheimer passenger ferry on excursion boats, 21 Mar–1 Nov 2026; roughly every 1–1.5 h ~10:00–18:20. €2.90 single / €4.90 return. Suspended in low water (e.g. from 19 Sep 2026) – car ferry is the fallback.

places.name: Rüdesheim (Rhein) station
places.blurb: RB10 trains Wiesbaden / Frankfurt; 4 min walk to villa.

places.name: Bingen (Rhein) Hbf
places.blurb: Left-bank trains to Mainz, Koblenz; cross via ferry.

places.name: Breuer's Rüdesheimer Schloss
places.blurb: 4* family wine hotel in a 1729 building off the Drosselgasse; top-rated in town. Price guide: €€€ (~€170–260).

places.name: Hotel Trapp
places.blurb: Family-run, central near the Drosselgasse; strong reviews. Price guide: €€ (~€110–170).

places.name: Rüdesheimer Hof
places.blurb: Traditional hotel with wine terrace at the edge of the old town. Price guide: €€ (~€100–160).

places.name: Ringhotel Central Superior
places.blurb: 4* superior, Kirchstraße, quiet but central; pool/spa. Price guide: €€ (~€130–190).

places.name: Hotel Lindenwirt
places.blurb: Wine-tavern hotel (incl. wine-barrel rooms) on the Drosselgasse; lively. Price guide: €€ (~€100–150).

places.name: Parkhotel Rüdesheim
places.blurb: Large riverside hotel on Rheinstraße – closest big room block to the villa. Price guide: €€ (~€100–160).

places.name: Hotel Rheinstein
places.blurb: Riverfront hotel on Rheinstraße, steps from the villa. Price guide: €€ (est.).

places.name: Rheinhotel Rüdesheim
places.blurb: 4* hotel with rooftop pool and Rhine views, east end of town. Price guide: €€–€€€ (est.).

places.name: Hotel Jagdschloss Niederwald
places.blurb: Former hunting lodge in the forest above town; quiet, scenic, needs car/taxi or chairlift+walk. Price guide: €€–€€€.

places.name: Hotel Krone Assmannshausen
places.blurb: Historic 1541 riverside hotel with pool in Assmannshausen; 1 train stop / boat from Rüdesheim. Price guide: €€–€€€.

places.name: NH Bingen
places.blurb: Modern chain hotel on Bingen riverfront across the Rhine; good for larger blocks; ferry to Rüdesheim (last car ferry ~23:50). Price guide: €€ (est.).

places.name: Niederwald Monument (Niederwalddenkmal)
places.blurb: 1883 Germania monument high above the vineyards; huge Rhine views.

places.name: Rüdesheim cable car (Seilbahn) base station
places.blurb: Gondola over the vineyards to the Niederwald Monument; combo "Ring ticket" with chairlift + boat.

places.name: Drosselgasse
places.blurb: 144 m alley of wine taverns with live music – Rüdesheim's classic evening stroll.

places.name: Siegfried's Mechanical Music Cabinet
places.blurb: Museum of self-playing instruments in the Brömserhof, with demonstrations.

places.name: Brömserburg (Rheingau Wine Museum)
places.blurb: One of the Rhine's oldest castles, next door to the villa; home of the wine museum.

places.name: Ehrenfels castle ruins
places.blurb: 13th-c. ruin on the Rüdesheimer Berg vineyards; reachable on the vineyard hiking trails.

places.name: Abbey of St. Hildegard, Eibingen
places.blurb: Benedictine abbey founded by Hildegard von Bingen tradition; church, shop, nuns' wine.

places.name: Assmannshausen chairlift
places.blurb: Currently out of service (until further notice, as of Oct 2026). Chairlift from Assmannshausen up to the Niederwald.

places.name: Jagdschloss Niederwald & Rheinsteig ridge walk
places.blurb: Easy forest walk Niederwald Monument → Temple → Rossel ruin → Jagdschloss (Rheinsteig).

places.name: Kloster Eberbach
places.blurb: Cistercian monastery ("Name of the Rose" filming), wine estate & tastings; ~20 min by car.

places.name: Weinprobierstand Rüdesheim
places.blurb: Open-air wine-tasting stand by the market – try local Riesling.

places.name: Weingut Georg Breuer
places.blurb: Renowned Riesling estate in the old town; tastings in its vinothek.

places.name: Asbach Uralt visitor centre
places.blurb: Home of Asbach brandy and Rüdesheimer Kaffee; shop/tastings. (approx. coordinates)

places.name: Mäuseturm (Mouse Tower), Bingen
places.blurb: Legendary toll tower on a Rhine island at the Binger Loch; best seen from the boat or Bingen bank.

places.name: Burg Rheinstein
places.blurb: Romantic castle above Trechtingshausen; boat stop with own pier.

places.name: Bingen Kulturufer & Museum am Strom
places.blurb: Riverside park promenade; Hildegard of Bingen exhibition.
